description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You apply a healing Graft to a creature within reach.

The suture goes in on the way past. Neither of you stops walking.

Immediately after the Graft resolves, you Step. If you applied it to someone other than yourself, that creature may Step instead of you, at their choice.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule element automatically grants a Step upon another action's resolution -- only player-triggered movement exists. The "ally Steps instead" branch is additionally This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass.
